title: Thandizani My Quiet Bible
description: My Quiet Bible ndi yaulere kwa aliyense, nthawi zonse. Ngati ikukuthandizani, mungathe kuthandiza kuti nyali ipitirire kuyaka.
sub: Zaulere kwa aliyense, nthawi zonse. Ngati ikukuthandizani, mungathe kuthandiza kuti nyali ipitirire kuyaka.
kofiSub: Kamodzi, kapena mwezi uliwonse. Ndi khadi, Apple Pay kapena Google Pay, popanda kulembetsa.
leave: Imatseguka patsamba latsopano. Bwererani kuno, kapena ku Baibulo, mukamaliza.
btcSub: On-chain kapena Lightning, molunjika ku seva yathu, popanda wapakati kapena munthu wina.
btcAddressQr: Khodi ya QR ya adiresi ya Bitcoin
where:
• Maseva amene amapangitsa kugwirizanitsa ndi magulu kugwira ntchito.
  • Mayina a domeni, kuti myquietbible.com ipitirire kugwira ntchito.
  • Imelo imene imatumiza makhodi olowera.
never: Palibe chilichonse m'Baibulo chimene chidzatsekedwa. Kupereka ndi kuthokoza, osati tikiti yolowera, ndipo palibe chimene chimasintha mu pulogalamu kaya mwapereka kapena ayi.
tax: My Quiet Bible si bungwe lachifundo lolembetsedwa, choncho mphatso sizichepetsa msonkho wanu.
other:
• Pempherani ntchito iyi, ndi anthu amene amawerenga nayo.
  • Tumizani myquietbible.com kwa munthu amene angakonde Baibulo labata.
about: Kodi My Quiet Bible ndi chiyani?
